newsitem.title: FRANCE: French bond future sets new contract high.
newsitem.headline: French bond future sets new contract high.

text.p: 0720 GMT - Sept bond future creeps above previous high of 129.92 but no surge, volume very low. Analysts said Prime Minister Lionel Jospin's Thursday interview showed a pragmatic approach to French deficit problems, no adverse market reaction.
*5.50 2007 OAT yield 5.49 pct vs 5.50. Bund spread -10 vs -11
*Call money unch at 3-1/8 1/4 pct. Sept PIBOR unch 96.57
